beats.text: With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Stonebridge's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.

📯 The Bloodied II's court summons Haven's speaker. SWEAR the oath of the realm (a gift seals it), SERVE at their court (seven days of your speaker's life), or WALK — break the link and stay a free fire, refusing the scale itself with it (the offer does not return). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
With Haven grieving, The Bloodied II installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
